title: Leave a loop early with stop
objective: Use stop to end a loop before its normal end, and know what runs next.

body.text: stop ends the loop straight away, even if the loop has more items or its condition is still true. The program carries on with the line after the loop. Put stop inside an if, so it only happens when the condition is met.

body.title: Stop at the first match
body.code:
make target equal to "bo"
make things equal to a list of "ana", "bo", "cy"
repeat for each item in things
    if item is equal to target
        stop
    say item
say "done"

body.text: stop also works with repeat while and repeat times. Here the loop would run 100 times, but stop ends it once the health is no longer above zero.

body.title: Stop when health runs out
body.code:
make changing health equal to 10
repeat 100 times using turn
    decrease health by 3
    if health is at most 0
        stop
say health

body.prompt: The program prints every item of the list, but it should stop as soon as it reaches bo, so only ana is printed. Make it print only ana.
body.starter:
make things equal to a list of "ana", "bo", "cy"
repeat for each item in things
    say item
body.solution:
make things equal to a list of "ana", "bo", "cy"
repeat for each item in things
    if item is equal to "bo"
        stop
    say item

checks.description: It uses stop inside the loop
